name: place-object
title: Place a held object
signature: place(object: object_ref, receptacle: receptacle_ref, hint_xy: xy?, pass_by: pose2d?)
description: Put the right-held object down on a support surface or into an open container and release it. How it is put down is chosen automatically from the receptacle and grasp: into a microwave (insert, release, withdraw), into a container, an edge-held flat object slid back over an edge, onto an ordinary surface (optionally near a hint point), or while driving past.
use_when: A held object must end up resting on a support, in a container or on a burner.

not_to_be_confused_with.drop: drop releases above a container opening without lowering.
not_to_be_confused_with.stack: stack targets another object's top face.
not_to_be_confused_with.release: release opens the fingers where the object already rests.

receptacle.description: A support surface or an open container.

hint_xy.description: Optional preferred position on a surface.

pass_by.description: Optional base waypoint: place while driving past.

applicability.summary: Requires holding(hand=right, object=$object); base_near(place=$receptacle). Some bound nouns add preconditions (see Conditions that depend on the bound nouns).

preconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
Joint at least 60 % of the way from closed to its annotated open value.

postconditions.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
Object centre inside the appliance cavity box (microwave) or body box (refrigerator).

preconditions.meaning: Joint at least 60 % of the way from closed to its annotated open value.

postconditions.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
Object centre inside the appliance cavity box (microwave) or body box (refrigerator).

preconditions.meaning: Joint at least 60 % of the way from closed to its annotated open value.

postconditions.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.

preconditions.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.

postconditions.meaning: Object centre inside the container's wall profile, between its floor and 3 cm above the rim.
Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
Object bottom on the stove's burner disc (3 cm radial and height tolerance).
Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.
typical: object not on/in target after release

arg_formats.pose2d: a base pose [x, y, yaw_deg] in metres and degrees
arg_formats.receptacle_ref: a support surface or an open container
arg_formats.xy: a world position [x, y] in metres

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
